svg.text: FLY HIGH: CLOUD PALACE — 5 EXPERIENCE BADGES (1:1 · 512×512)
Desain Vektor Siap Impor ke Figma & Unggah Roblox Badge (Bingkai Aman Lingkaran, Name & Description English Ringkas)

div.style: font-family: Nunito, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.45; color: #E2E8F0; font-weight: 600;

foreignObject.div: Set foot on the departure dock and begin your journey into the skies of Fly High.

div.style: font-family: Nunito, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.45; color: #E2E8F0; font-weight: 600;

foreignObject.div: Touch down at the Cloud Palace summit for the very first time.

div.style: font-family: Nunito, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.45; color: #E2E8F0; font-weight: 600;

foreignObject.div: Climb past 5,000 km and soar into the twilight stratosphere.

div.style: font-family: Nunito, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.45; color: #E2E8F0; font-weight: 600;

foreignObject.div: Shoot down 10 airborne threats protecting your balloon and crew.

div.style: font-family: Nunito, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.45; color: #E2E8F0; font-weight: 600;

foreignObject.div: Reach the Cloud Palace summit 10 times. A true master of the skies.
